1. Consultation Request
2. Prescription Request
3. Lab Request

5. Add Consultation
6. Add Prescription
7. Add Lab

Guards:
1. Consultation Request within 3 years
2. Prescription Request within 3 years
3. Lab Request within 3 years
4. Look-up Request within 3 years
5. Consultation not already in history
6. Prescription not already in history
7. Lab not already in history
8. Look-up not already in history

1. Initial -> Consultation History
2. Consultation History -> Prescription History
3. Prescription History -> Lab Request History
4. Lab Request History -> Look-up Request History
5. Look-up Request History -> Prescription & Invoice Look-up
6. Prescription & Invoice Look-up -> Initial

Mode-switching behavior:
1. Consultation Request -> Consultation History
2. Prescription Request -> Prescription History
3. Lab Request -> Lab Request History
4. Look-up Request -> Look-up Request History
